title: About
text: Hi! My name is Ella Cave, I am a junior student at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln studying Sports Media Communications and Broadcasting, minoring in Hospitality. I am interested in a career in sports media that includes either broadcasting or digital media. While being at UNL I have been able to write game stories, cover sporting events, and much more. I also have experience in social media through working with Hurrdat Sports as a Social Media Intern. I like to share stories about athletes, teams, and people behind just sports. Outside of school I enjoy hanging out with friends and family, being involved in Alpha Omicron Pi, and going to sports events.

title: What Makes a Successful College Basketball Team?
text:
This is a story about Women’s College Basketball and how the University of Nebraska-Omaha compares to other college basketball teams.
Scoring points is one of the biggest ways teams win games, but it isn’t the only thing that contributes to a win. A team’s defense and ability to handle the basketball can also create a huge difference in a game. Now, in women’s college basketball, some teams score a lot more points on average than other teams, but does that mean they are more successful than other lower-scoring teams?
For this project, I wanted to look at women’s college basketball team stats from the 2025-26 season because I wanted to see what stats might be related to the success of teams. I also want to look at the average points scored, the average points teams allow, and their turnover margin. Then connect that to how the University of Nebraska-Omaha women’s basketball team compares to others.
My first chart is a bar chart talking about the women’s college basketball teams with the highest average points and how UNO differs from them.

  labs(
    x="Teams", 
    y="Average Points Per Game", 
    title="How Does UNO Compare to the Highest-Scoring Teams?", 
    subtitle="Average points per game for the top 15 scoring teams in Women's College Basketball, with Omaha highlighted in red.", 
    caption="Source: Sports-Reference | By Ella Cave"
    ) +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
  )









If you look at the chart above, you can see that there’s a big difference between the top 15 scoring teams and UNO. The top teams are averaging 75 + points per game, and UNO is averaging a little more than 50. This chart shows that UNO scores a lot less per game than the top 15 teams. As I said before scoring does help team win games, but doesn’t mean they are successful all together. Before we think of everything all together, let’s look at a scatterplot comparing UNO’s and the top 15 teams average points scored and average points allowed. This will show whether they have strong defenses and offenses when they win.
